notes: Is update me PrimeFeed ka About page bilkul naye design me aa gaya hai — saaf parichay, saari suvidhaon ki list (Local, National aur World News, Hindi & English, AI-Powered News, News Verification, Latest Updates, Premium Experience) aur neeche hamari verification wali line. Saath me app ke andar pehle se rakhi taazi khabron ka packet bhi update kar diya gaya hai. Sports category wala pichla fix bhi isme shamil hai.
